verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a government web service such as the FTB's site and MyFTB, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains only two 403 edge-denial probes and nothing about analytics, tracking, or opt-out controls. With no evidence of the capability, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
